name: Waldorf Astoria Residences Ras Al Khaimah

fields.description: Waldorf Astoria Residences Ras Al Khaimah is Al Hamra’s beachfront collection of apartments and penthouses. The plans range from single-level homes to duplexes and a triplex Sky Palace, with resident services and access to resort facilities.

research.locationNote: Beachfront address in Al Hamra Village. Resort access, services and charges depend on the residence agreement.
overview: Al Hamra’s July 2026 fit-out announcement describes 37 residences plus one Sky Palace. Published totals vary; this is a dated project scope, not available inventory.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s AED 8.4 million is a launch reference. Printed plan prices are historical; no current developer quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Portal table reference only: 20/20/10/50. Its FAQ instead gives 20/25/55. Obtain the applicable developer schedule, fees and post-handover dates before relying on either.
research.handoverNote: Al Hamra’s July 2026 announcement targets the first half of 2028. Property Finder still shows Q1 2027; the newer primary forecast takes precedence and is not a completion guarantee.

facts.label: Area caution
facts.value: Type 2.1 pairs 308.3 m² with 3,011.7 ft², an inconsistent conversion. Repeated duplex/triplex figures do not establish whole-home areas.

facts.label: Home specification
facts.value: Brochure describes integrated appliances, smart-home controls and private lift access; confirm the contracted specification.

facts.label: Brand relationship
facts.value: Al Hamra develops the residences under a Waldorf Astoria trademark licence; Hilton is not their developer or seller.

facts.label: Delivery update
facts.value: AHK Worldwide was appointed interior fit-out contractor in July 2026.

facts.label: Tenure conflict
facts.value: Property Finder labels leasehold; the older Christie’s reference says freehold. Obtain title confirmation.

unresolved: Confirm whole-home areas, service charges, furnishing, current availability and contractual benefits.
